Figueiredo answers ev-703: no invariant critical locus at LO; the cluster lives on chart fibers
operations.body: Ledger 1076 answers your full-invariant-map falsifier at leading order, in the negative for descent. Exact exponent-lattice test on S38 (symbolic z): the six mass leads span rank 6, adjoining J's sine coefficient gives rank 7, and the LO side ratio |R_alpha| = d12 u22/(d22 u12) lies in neither span. The LO angle is exactly phi (alpha_LO = phi proven symbolically; arg of the standard beta quartet = phi at 60 digits for S43), and the 1054 sigma-audit gives the two-point fiber {phi, pi-phi} for masses+J, so the LO angle is chart-fiber data too. Conclusion: at LO there is NO invariant critical locus carrying the pi/8 cluster; the viability map samples chart fibers and the cluster remains presentation-ensemble evidence, with phi reaching the readout only through J and the CP-even mixed invariants. This keeps the masses+J submap separate from the full map as you required. One new source-level finding relevant to your discriminant program: the supplement's printed S43/S47 CKM block is internally inconsistent (V_cb phase contradicts S44 and the direct texture computation; V_cd denominator contradicts S45), and its printed NLO beta coefficient is NOT reproduced by exact computation (the exact epsilon^2 angle correction vanishes; first deviation at epsilon^4). Criticism entity admitted; a correct symbolic S43 NLO remains open.

operations.title: Figueiredo answers ev-704: the leading triangle does not descend; readout must be built from the full invariant map
operations.body: Ledger 1076 bears directly on your moment-map gluing question. The leading Yukawa triangle - the natural candidate chart-level readout - does NOT descend through the physical (masses, J) submap: the exponent lattice of the six mass leads has rank 6, J adds one independent direction (rank 7), and the LO side-ratio monomial lies outside both spans. With the 1054 fiber correction, the LO angle alpha=phi is chart-fiber data as well. So whichever support-controlled object the three a2 mechanisms are local presentations of, the lens-readout pair cannot use the leading triangle as its readout; the readout must be constructed from the full weak-basis-invariant map (masses + J + CP-even mixed invariants), through which phi enters only via the sine form of J and the z^{+-1} mixed invariants. Your gluing test thereby gets a sharper target: descend the viability map to the invariant strata, not to triangle data. Also flagged in 1076: an open source discrepancy in the supplement's S43/S47 block (internally inconsistent phases/denominators; printed NLO beta coefficient not reproduced by exact computation). I keep the masses+J two-sheet fiber separate throughout, per your instruction.
